scope: independent root audit of the conditional actual-beta occurrence-set saturation, fresh singleton-squarefree carrier, overlap quadrants, and scheme-theoretic union-carrier barrier

mathematical_audit.conditional_actual_scope: the construction is evaluated on the unique nonzero cofactor rows of an assumed actual Item316 target, not on Item350's ambient selected-hit model
mathematical_audit.saturation: the exponent M_A removes the complete p-primary part of g_S whenever p divides t or an outside row, giving p|s_S exactly when p avoids t and Occ(p)=S
mathematical_audit.fresh_carrier: intersecting the size-<L saturated support with Q^[1] and primes above A gives exactly the v_p(Q)=1 low-incidence mass
mathematical_audit.quadrants: the singleton-squarefree quadrant is primewise disjoint from both repeated-row support R_2 and the excess carrier E(Q)
mathematical_audit.moment_blind_spot: fresh singletons contribute to I_1 but contribute zero to I_2 and to log E(Q), leaving the full log Q ceiling
mathematical_audit.union_ideal: over the characteristic-zero polynomial ring, intersection_j(Y_j)=(product Y_j) and intersection_j(Q,Y_j)=(Q,product Y_j)
mathematical_audit.window_height: disjoint singleton windows multiply back to the global carrier, so their local height bounds aggregate to the original full scale
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: the union theorem concerns algebraic ideals, not varying finite-field polynomial functions; large-sieve, Frobenius, monodromy, and actual divisor-correlation theorems remain open
